acquisition_H1.comparison: donor as trained versus exact warm anchor, paired on all250 fixed rows

exact_discordance_attainability.zero_discordance: UNCERTIFIABLE, cannot pass either gate; no binomial tail is fabricated

acquisition_H1.metric: strict body pass@1; preserve every attempt with no refill
acquisition_H1.multiple_arm_rule: Bonferroni over all selected H1 arms; exact one-sided per-arm alpha=0.05/n_selected. No arm selection after outputs.
acquisition_H1.paired_choice_interpretation: Both predeclared arms must use their adjusted H1 threshold and net>=13 gate; neither arm is selected after outputs. Teacher-order arm-to-arm contrast is descriptive single-seed feasibility unless separately registered.
acquisition_H1.zero_or_low_discordance: UNCERTIFIABLE, never null; cannot pass H1

evaluation.baseline: exact deployed warm common anchor; original Supa is an additional source-retention reference, not an acquisition comparator

baseline_enrollment.churn_rule: 0 changed generated token-ID sequences between independent processes, otherwise STOP_NONDETERMINISTIC
baseline_enrollment.memberships: C_(model,bank) = IDs strictly correct in that model's first complete fixed-bank read; second read validates zero churn only

evaluation.composition_claim: NOT_TESTED; independent R/S/P donors, nonpartners, twins, operating doses and full composition panel still required

natural_language_preservation.reason: governing protocol identifies no separate natural-language bank; no substitution by verifiable legacy tasks
natural_language_preservation.required_future_decision: separately name, license, freeze IDs/denominators/metric/margin/budget before any language-preservation claim

evaluation.sealed_policy: no model outputs from these roles in this qualification/training/DEV proposal; any confirmatory follow-up requires a separately frozen read plan

source_retention.claim_status: exposed diagnostic retention only; not confirmatory no-forgetting, natural-language or whole-model preservation

1/10.interpretation: zero-loss attainability only; actual positive-loss CP upper bound must still pass; empty denominators are UNCERTIFIABLE

1/20.interpretation: zero-loss attainability only; actual positive-loss CP upper bound must still pass; empty denominators are UNCERTIFIABLE

source_retention.denominator_rule: all source-correct IDs in the named fixed bank; publish exact IDs/hash and n after baseline enrollment; no donor-dependent membership
source_retention.empty_or_small_membership: UNCERTIFIABLE if the zero-loss CP bound exceeds the declared margin; report no preservation claim
source_retention.family_reporting: Report source-correct n, losses and repairs separately for every legacy family; the pooled5% diagnostic margin does not certify individual families.
source_retention.interval: one-sided95% Clopper-Pearson binomial diagnostic upper bound for losses/n; population confidence is conditional on the explicitly declared model assumptions
source_retention.loss: source correct and donor wrong; gains/repairs on source-wrong IDs separate and never netted

guard_dev_legacy.status: PROPOSED_DIAGNOSTIC_USE_OF_PRIOR_mL; governing guard_dev is not confirmatory

statistical_assumptions.Clopper_Pearson: The binomial diagnostic confidence interpretation requires conditional independent Bernoulli losses with a common probability, or another valid justification for the binomial model. Exchangeability alone does not establish a binomial count distribution.
statistical_assumptions.cross_bank_dependence: DEV R/S/P share parent worlds, so do not pool them into750 independent worlds. H1 Bonferroni remains valid without independence between arms, subject to each exact test's own assumptions.
statistical_assumptions.finite_bank: Loss/gain counts on these fixed exposed banks are exact finite-bank measurements; they do not by themselves establish population inference.
statistical_assumptions.parent_clusters: Within every endpoint bank require one row per independent parent/world. If parents repeat, use parent/world clusters and a separately registered valid clustered analysis; never treat repeated rows as independent.

source_retention.warm_preexisting_losses: report Supa-correct/warm-wrong losses beside final donor losses; warmed enrollment never erases original-source losses

native_backend.asset_metadata_purpose: exact raw UTF8 receipt preserving source CRLF; SHA binds declared file/header sizes for pure known-work lower bounds before asset reads. These are analytical minima, not measured prices.

native_ledger_artifact_interface.cleanup_profile_requirement: native ledger cleanup.wall_s_upper covers the whole admitted model lifetime and is reserved before frameworks/models; final release-only timing is insufficient

construction.bindings: exact reviewed code map, runtime preimage, static native recipe,154-entry F32 inventory, common/own warm anchors, actual V2 ingestion receipt and3000 prepared-row hash/cost bindings
construction.caps: complete finite native journal kind profiles/attempt ceilings/metadata census; qualification upper profiles need separate explicit approval; production profiles must be measured/sealed and fit hard ceilings
construction.ingestion_receipt_sha256: the actual self-digest of the selected complete V2 tokenizer ingestion receipt, not the root receipt raw SHA
construction.owned_directory: the explicit selected phase/arm output directory plus ledger; outside source checkout
construction.plan: exact full375-boundary teacher plan below; no synthetic plan replacement

native_ledger_artifact_interface.execution_policy: this interface is not a retained ledger artifact, execution permit or grant; do not create a fictitious native_ledger_ref hash from the proposal
native_ledger_artifact_interface.metadata_roots_requirement: native ledger bindings.metadata_roots must equal [the exact admitted native_backend.output_directory], not merely its ledger subdirectory; metadata paths must resolve inside that owned root. CPU fixtures retain their journal-only rule.

required_registration_reference_shape.path: absolute owned phase/arm ledger specification JSON path
required_registration_reference_shape.sha256: actual raw-file SHA256 after complete approved scope/source/profile freeze; no placeholder hash

native_backend.nested_operation_profiles: CE core/checkpoint/journal profiles require complete bounded census and measured qualification costs before production admission
native_backend.source_freeze: all native/backend/core/CP/journal/runtime/scorer/authority source hashes must be collected AFTER reviewed implementation, committed clean and bound before qualification approval; proposal itself supplies no verifier registration

phase_authorization: operator choice, qualification-only scope, and subsequent measured production/evaluation scope are separately required; previous warm grant is exhausted

production_plan.after_DEV_failure: remove that arm; no recipe/checkpoint selection, retraining or repeated DEV gate
production_plan.failed_unknown_costs: charged permanently; restore changes logical progress only and never refunds reservations
production_plan.resume_policy: at most one documented technical resume, only after the prior worker handle is confirmed terminal; latest valid checkpoint, no fallback from corruption, no automatic retries

prospective_production_hard_caps.conditional_totals: sum independent per-arm caps using selected arm_count; one shared fixed-baseline/evaluation cap, no concurrent GPU arms
prospective_production_hard_caps.production_admission: recompute complete measured full-unit/IO/metadata/resource price projections from actual qualified operations; must fit these proposed hard ceilings AND a separately approved frozen measured-production scope or STOP
prospective_production_hard_caps.wall_accounting: 129600s charged-wall ceiling includes43200s operation reservations,43200s prepaid cleanup lifetime and43200s journal tick_wall. Physical job deadline remains43200s; outer summaries do not recharge native costs.

qualification.attempt_policy: one attempt per stage; failure/unknown work retains its full reservation and stops; no unregistered repeats

checkpoint_accounting_bound.additional_costs: child constructor/bootstrap/source/handle/RPC/lease/reload/final-publication work must remain separately prepaid in final approved accounting profiles; source metadata arithmetic does not supply those measured costs.
checkpoint_accounting_bound.corruption_copy_rule: three separate child-owned copies, whole payload+64MiB metadata read/write allowances plus one mutated byte per copy; original checkpoints retained, no symlink/foreign file mutation
checkpoint_accounting_bound.state_fingerprint_rule: twelve full live parameter/Adam/module/Python/NumPy/CPU/CUDA RNG digest snapshots: before/after-corrupt/after-stale/after-good-recovery in each branch; separately declared analytical hash allowance, not a measured upper price

checkpoint_branch_counts.ancestry_reason: NativeCheckpoints.save validates full exact history/U/generation and live state; first save at qualifiedU1/U2 is permitted. NativeCheckpoints.restore requires a retained checkpoint; its caller cannot invent an ancestor.
checkpoint_branch_counts.caps_rule: all attempted native restore work consumes full reservation, including corruption rejection. Optional C0 saves are bounded allowances, not implicit additional attempts or grants.

criteria.adam_clipping: at least two actual native CE8 Adam steps; clip1/norm2 before every Adam; actual U advances once; lazy state fresh atU0; all gradients finite/confined and all frozen parameters/buffers bitwise unchanged
criteria.checkpoint_resume: initial/save-after-update checkpoints; two separate OS processes; uninterrupted versus restored next update exact parameter/Adam/module-mode/Python/NumPy/TorchCPU/CUDA RNG bytes; stale fences and corrupted latest payload reject without fallback/mutation; failed/unknown reservations remain charged
criteria.delta_roundtrip: extract common-warm-reference FP32 delta (not relative to last qualification update); stream <=1MiB; retain file/data/state digests, final master and rebuilt deployed endpoint digests plus explicit FP32 rounding residual max/L2; never assume those two endpoints bitwise equal
criteria.ingestion_tokenizer: revalidate all canonical/policy TRAIN and selected teacher records, exact3000 IDs/order/targets, summed P/C/S census, terminalEOS, no truncation and every independently bound witness

gradient_reference.objective: equal eight rows after each row's selected-token mean; independent reference, finite confined gradients and fixed loss denominator8
gradient_reference.rule: difference_L2 <= abs_tol + rel_tol*reference_L2, including zero reference; max_coordinate_error <=abs_tol and <=difference_L2

likelihood_gradient_parity.independent_likelihood_paths: incremental-cache/prefix versus full-sequence teacher; also padded/unpadded controls, no scorer-dependent likelihood

criteria.longest_masks: all witness rows: labels positionsP..P+C-1, predictor positionsP-1..P+C-2, zero prompt/pad labels and exactly one terminalEOS
criteria.resource_io_measurement: record every started/failed/returned physical operation and retained artifacts; actual elapsed/hash/IO/RSS/GPU/disk samples; source-bound execution handles; replay ledger hash chain; reserve artifact/ledger readback work before verification
criteria.runtime_anchor: actual FP32 CUDA runtime equals pinned preimage; exact warm full-state digest; BF16 source roundtrip and tied-head alias; fresh Adam; non-reentrant decoder/head; two identical forwards bitwise

deferred_cleanup_lifetime_reservation.accounting: reserve this entire lifetime before model work; keep the reservation charged alongside nested operations, including failures/unknowns
deferred_cleanup_lifetime_reservation.ends: after final model/Adam/CUDA cleanup or sealed failure

negative_control_state_fingerprint_bound.complete_profile_requirement: state_proof_bounds must additionally cover actual CPU/CUDA RNG tensors and canonical module/group/Python/NumPy metadata before any hashing; actual shape census still requires qualification.

qualification.qualification_weights: disposable; restore/reset from common warm anchor for each independent qualification trajectory and production arm; never reused as an acquired donor
qualification.wall_accounting_policy: One native journal charges operation reservations, prepaid cleanup lifetime and tick_wall separately. Outer controller bookkeeping charges only its own bootstrap/verification work within the stage-operation envelope; stage summaries reference native charges and must not charge them again. Any separate additional outer tick counter must be added in a newly approved envelope before execution.

canonical.prepared_hash_bytes_rule: exact canonical ASCII bytes hashed for prompt IDs, completion IDs and prepared {id,prompt_ids,completion_ids}; measured during actual token re-render, not estimated from lengths

permuted.prepared_hash_bytes_rule: exact canonical ASCII bytes hashed for prompt IDs, completion IDs and prepared {id,prompt_ids,completion_ids}; measured during actual token re-render, not estimated from lengths

witnesses.gradient_boundary_selection: For each teacher arm: first ordered witness of maxP,maxC,maxS, in that fixed field order with deduplication; then append remaining witness-union IDs in full TRAIN exposure order, then ordinary TRAIN IDs if needed, until eight unique IDs. Masks/parity still cover ALL witnesses.
witnesses.no_fabricated_joint_extreme: maxP+maxC=1288 is not a measured row; maximum sequence remains1287
witnesses.selection: all exact TRAIN row IDs attaining each maximum independently in each chosen teacher plan; use retained prepared-token hashes; compare plan/preparation/tokenizer refs before any model access

resource_envelope.disk_rule: guard floor+outstanding active reservations before each operation; cumulative read/write caps are costs, not actual free-space requirements; owned rolling artifacts only
resource_envelope.failure: STOP_HOST_INFEASIBLE/STOP_BUDGET or sealed failure; do not change approved gates, kill user apps or reuse live work
resource_envelope.host_fit_rule: measured peakRSS+1GiB <= free RAM at launch; launch floor is proposed5.5GiB, not inherited qualification
resource_envelope.reserved_fit_rule: max_reserved <=0.95*0.78*actual_gpu_total; no CPU Adam/offload, lower precision or alternate inventory fallback

seeds.paired_policy: same native run seed and ordered exposures, fresh independent model/Adam starts; one seed is a feasibility comparison
seeds.python_numpy_torch_cpu_cuda: initialize all before model instantiation; numpy seed modulo2^32; restore all actual RNG state on a technical resume
